This is an aggressive phishing operation using "tips@bayareatimes.com" email address or similar email addresses to flood my inbox with unsolicited scam messages. Emails arrive from aliases like growth@bayareatimes.com, info@bayareatimes.com, and tips@bayareatimes.com, and this scammer rotates addresses daily to bypass spam filters and trick recipients into engaging. The messages are flagged as phishing by mail servers, and clicking links or downloading attachments can compromise your personal data. Do not click on any links.

Since October 2025, I have received over 590 unsolicited prerecorded calls promoting supposed personal loans/debt relief. I have NEVER applied for a loan, answered these calls, returned a call, or consented to these solicitations. The callers continually rotate/spoof caller-ID numbers while directing recipients to recurring callback numbers using fictitious stories. Recent messages claim I have an existing “file,” that supervisors/underwriters have reviewed it, and, often lately, that numerous employees have repeatedly tried to reach me. This caller offered unsolicited "time sensitive resolution options" to my supposedly unpaid taxes. I don't owe any taxes. Other recordings use similar fictitious personal stories and loan approvals. I have preserved numerous voicemails, screenshots, dates, caller-ID numbers and callback numbers and have reported this to the FTC numerous times. This appears to be a large-scale, persistent robocall campaign, not isolated calls.
